marketData.summary: 0/3 Bitget market-data endpoints reachable - connection-reset: TCP connection reset by peer before any HTTP response
marketData.disclosure: The Bitget official MCP server and the Bitget web/API hosts are unreachable from the network this build ran on (every attempt fails at the TCP layer, not the application layer). AnalogDesk therefore ships no Bitget-sourced MARKET figure. All data comes from the keyless sources in research/DATA-PROVENANCE.md, and this disclosure is rendered in the provenance panel rather than hidden.

bitget.summary: 0/3 Bitget market-data endpoints reachable - connection-reset: TCP connection reset by peer before any HTTP response; Bitget hackathon LLM gateway reachable (HTTP 401, 3519ms) - this is the endpoint the narrative layer calls
bitget.disclosure: Two separate Bitget integrations, two separate results. MARKET DATA: the official Bitget MCP server for US stocks/ETFs and both Bitget web/API hosts are unreachable from this network (connection-reset: TCP connection reset by peer before any HTTP response), so AnalogDesk ships no Bitget-sourced market figure; every number comes from the keyless sources in research/DATA-PROVENANCE.md. NARRATIVE: the Bitget-operated hackathon LLM gateway at https://hackathon.bitgetops.com/v1 IS reachable (HTTP 401 on an unauthenticated probe), and it is the endpoint the narrative layer calls with model qwen3.8-max - the prose a reviewer reads was generated there. This distinction is reported rather than collapsed into a single badge, because either collapse would overstate or understate the integration.
